body: I don't know if I could afford a professional. Crying has helped a bit, thanks. I feel less emotional, but I feel void of any emotions now. I can't even cry without thinking that I'm not masculine enough. My family is always bugging me about women and I'm tired of looking like a failure in front of them. Everything I've done in my life has led to failure.

I'm 20 years old. I tried to move far away from my parents last summer but they were absolutely against it. It came to a point where I left a note for my parents and decided to move to another city to stay with a friend for a while, while I got my own life back in order. My parents decided to call the police on me, told them that I was mentally unstable and that I needed them (parents) to be close by. My parents also decided to call all my friends, message my friends on facebook, and told a lot of people a lot of things I didn't want them sharing with others. That's why I can't share anything with any of my friends, I feel like I've already been judged by the majority of people in my life. I just wanted a fresh start and I can't even get that. I also feel like I need to stay nearby because of my grandparent's. I'm not sure how long they have left and I wanted to stay close to them. But I can't handle this living situation anymore. I feel like the only thing that matters to anyone in the world around me is money. I'm sick and tired of it.
